proposals.order: NLO generator × NNLO/NLO k-factor (inclusive W → ℓν, FEWZ NNLO in the table)
proposals.convention: No published total for a jet-multiplicity piece → generator × k-factor. The k-factor numerator is the same SECONDARY table as our DY (Matan, 15 Oct), for consistency. Not a paper table, so the 'k-factor from a paper table' rule is only partly met.
proposals.look: RazorAnalyzer xSections.dat line 64: 'WJetsToLNu_TuneCUETP8M1_13TeV-amcatnloFXFX-pythia8 61526.7'. The three portal values on the MiniAOD records 69714 / 69716 / 69718 (metadata.cross_section.total_value).
alternatives: k from the inclusive NLO sample instead (61526.7 / 66970)
primary source instead: ATLAS 1603.09222 Table 3, 3 × 20.08 nb = 60240 pb
proposals.notes: Portal matching efficiencies 0.9 / 0.2 / 0.1 are shown but NOT multiplied in. The three portal values add up to 65588 pb, close to the inclusive NLO sample's 66970 pb, which suggests total_value already includes the matching efficiency (if it did not, the pieces would sum to 50095 pb). Also, the inclusive NLO value 66970 pb × 0.4 = 26788 pb would be less than half of every W → ℓν prediction and measurement (ATLAS measured 3 × 20.64 nb), so for this record total_value must already include the matching efficiency. Evidence for the open point, not a decision.
